title: Meric's Wonderland
description: A large NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack focused on Create engineering, Aeronautics, exploration, world generation, food, decoration, and a richer survival experience.
body:
**Meric's Wonderland** is a large NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack built around engineering, exploration, world generation, food, decoration, and a more alive survival experience.

The core of the pack is **Create**. You can build factories, contraptions, automation lines, power systems, trains, cannons, machines, and complex mechanical setups. With **Create: Aeronautics**, your creations are not limited to the ground anymore — moving and flying structures become a major part of progression and experimentation.

Exploration is heavily expanded. The Overworld, Nether, End, and additional dimensions are filled with new biomes, improved terrain, villages, towers, dungeons, ruins, monuments, taverns, and other structures. Mods like **Biomes O’ Plenty**, **Tectonic**, **The Aether**, **YUNG’s Better** series, **Structory**, **Dungeons and Taverns**, and **Moog’s Structures** make travelling feel much more rewarding.

Survival also has more depth. **Farmer’s Delight** and its add-ons expand cooking, farming, and food progression, while new animals, mobs, villages, furniture, decorations, ambient effects, and quality-of-life features make the world feel less empty and more lived-in.

The pack also includes several performance and utility mods such as **Sodium**, **Iris**, **ModernFix**, **FerriteCore**, **Entity Culling**, **Distant Horizons**, **Jade**, **JEI/EMI**, **JourneyMap**, and **Spark** to improve playability and help with large worlds.

This is not a lightweight Vanilla+ pack. It is designed for players who want a bigger Minecraft experience with deeper engineering, richer exploration, better world generation, and more things to build, discover, and automate.

## Main Features

* Create-based automation, machinery, and contraptions
* Create: Aeronautics support for moving and flying structures
* Expanded world generation with new terrain, biomes, and structures
* The Aether dimension
* Improved villages, dungeons, caves, towers, monuments, and ruins
* Farmer’s Delight food progression and cooking add-ons
* More animals, mobs, decorations, furniture, and ambience
* Quality-of-life improvements for maps, tooltips, inventory, and information
* Performance-focused mods for a smoother large-pack experience
* Shader support through Iris

## When starting the server
If you plan to set up a server and play online, you’ll need to extract the client-side mods from the mod pack separately. Currently, these mods are:

- BetterF3
- Chat Heads
- Distant Horizons
- Entity Culling
- Fancy Toasts
- Iris/Colorwheel
- Not Enough Animations
- Obscure Tooltips
- Particular
- Potion Bar
- Skin Layers 3D
- Sodium
- Sound Physics Remastered
- Subtle Effects
- Wavey Capes
- Travelers Titles
- Punchy

In other words, these mods should not be in your server's mods folder. These are client side only.

## Recommended System

This modpack contains many world generation and structure mods. First world creation may take longer than usual.

Recommended allocated RAM: **8 GB minimum**, **10–12 GB preferred**.

Using shaders, Distant Horizons, and large render distances together can significantly increase system load.
